Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleep-overs in 'Theo's Big Night Out', then in 'The Bodyguard', Alvin decides he needs a personal bodyguard, and trains Theodore for the job.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried for Alvin's safety in 'The Karate Kidder', then in 'Playing Favourites', Alvin and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin must prove that alien life exists in 'Across the Universe', and in 'Britt's Picks', Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog, and vows to get him back.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off in 'He Said She Said', then in 'Attack of the Zombies', Alvin and Theodore try to protect their loved ones.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin suspects his neighbour is responsible for a recent heist in 'What A Gem', and in 'Family Spirit', Alvin tries to get out of the family picnic with Dave to go to a soccer game.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a 30-foot giant in 'Theozilla', then in 'Doggone It', all the phones at school are missing, and Alvin is blamed.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him in 'Brittany the Body Snatcher', and in 'Agent Smith', to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story ever seen.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin is convinced his mojo was in a cap he gave away in 'Mojo Missing', then in 'Who's The Animal', Alvin finds himself mistaken for a Tasmanian devil during a costume visit to the zoo.

Nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul-mate in 'Albrittina', then in 'Simon for President', Simon and Alvin decide to launch their own campaigns for class president.
